title: An Answered Letter Does Not Grow
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：response　|　正文 325 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 response 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My mother answered every letter she ever received, and she received a great many, because a ① response, she said, is the cheapest thing you can give somebody and the one most people withhold. Her ② response to bad news was to write at once and at length; her ③ response to good news was to wait a week, which she said was the only piece of discipline she had ever managed to keep.

There was ④ no response she despised more than the late one, and she was never late, not once in sixty-one years; she said a response given late is worse than none given at all. She wrote in longhand at the kitchen table, in the hour before the post, and she said the habit of answering was not kindness but self-defence: an unanswered letter grows, and an answered one does not, because a response, however short, is a thing finished.

In 1998 she wrote to the council eleven times about the same broken wall. She got one ⑤ response, four months late, saying the matter was under review. She wrote back ⑥ in response to that letter every week for a year, and the wall was mended in 2003.

What I inherited, and have not kept, is the discipline rather than the handwriting. My own first ⑦ response to a letter is to put it down, and my second is to forget it, and between the two there is usually a year.

In 2019 I took a course that asked for a written ⑧ response every week, and I handed in eleven out of twelve, which is the best record I have had at anything. The tutor asked us to ⑨ make a response of two hundred words to a question we had not chosen, and I wrote about my mother's kitchen table, and about the ⑩ response she would have given to a course like this, which is that eleven out of twelve is not a record but a confession.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 反应；应对方式（one's response to ...）
C. n. 第一反应；本能反应（one's first response）
D. 固定搭配：in response to 作为对……的回应
E. 固定搭配：make a response 作出回答／回应
F. 固定搭配：no response 没有回应；无人应答
G. n. （课程、问卷的）书面作答；答卷
H. n. （情绪上的）反应；反应方式

items.q: a response, she said, is the cheapest thing
Her response to bad news was to write at once
her response to good news was to wait a week
There was no response she despised more
She got one response, four months late
She wrote back in response to that letter
My own first response to a letter
asked us to make a response of two hundred words
the response she would have given to a course like this

answers.why: a response 意为“答复、回信”，母亲说答复是一个人能给别人的最便宜的东西。
one's response to ... 意为“对……的反应／应对方式”，她对坏消息是立刻长篇回信。
her response to good news 指情绪上的反应方式，对好消息她要等一周才回。
no response 意为“没有回应”，说她最鄙视的是迟到的答复。
one response 意为“一份答复”，四个月后才来，说事情在研究中。
in response to 意为“作为对……的回应”，她每周都回信回应那封信。
one's first response 意为“第一反应”，我对信件的第一反应是把它放下。
a written response 意为“书面作答”，那门课每周要求交一份书面作业。
make a response 意为“作出回答／回应”，导师要求我们就指定问题写二百字。
the response she would have given 意为“她会作出的反应／回应”，即她对这事的反应。
